Dr Hemal K Sanghavi (PT) has worked in many reputed hospitals like Bombay Hospital, Saifee Hospital, etc. Dr Hemal is HOD &  Director of Midway Home, Residential Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Centre. Under his leadership initiated Advanced IPD/Residential Rehab at Bombay Hospital. He is the founder of IAHR (Integrated Association of Health & Rehabilitation) He is the founder of Elite Physio & Rehab, Complete Home Health Care Solution. Dr Hemal Sanghavi (PT) strongly believes in giving back to society, & he is heading GGFMC Advanced Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Clinic, Andheri East (ventured by Lions club of Andheri East)

In Residential Rehabilitation centre available services are like Physiotherapy, Occupational therapy, Speech therapy, Dietitian, Acupuncture, Yoga, 24×7 Nursing & Care takers, Dietician guided Food/Meal, Physician, on call specialist Doctors, cognition therapy, Play Therapy, music therapy, recreational activities, etc.

Can contact@ 8446993833
